thread: rene (PM): Heads-up: quick UX pass on the Compliance settings modal. Key areas: retention phrasing, region dropdown label, and the encryption badge naming. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/compliance-modal. I made a tiny frame called 'Compliance / Org modal (v3)'. PTAL. tom (Designer): uploaded an iteration with compact rows and microcopy changes. Main question: should we call the field 'Region' or 'Storage region'? 'Data residency' came up in legal but it might be long in the compact layout. figma-bot: tom updated 'Compliance / Org modal (v3)' 4dd 1769460090 izzy (Security): Quick security notes: - Avoid 'KMS' as a user-facing label. Most customers won't know it. - Prefer 'Customer key (BYOK)' or 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Put the full form in a tooltip. - Show a small inline compatibility indicator when a key is selected that might be regional-only. kevin (Eng): Implementation notes: - 'Indefinite' retention state requires a flag in the retention service and extra DB flag. Fine but schedule it. - Region dropdown: if we change the label to 'Data residency', the backend still returns 'region' codes; we'll map in the client. - For key checks: we can call the KMS-compatibility endpoint after selection and surface a toast if mismatch. claire (Accessibility): a11y quick pass: - Contrast: the encryption pill (light-gray text on pale bg) fails 4.5:1. Make text darker or add a 1px border. - Keyboard: the region selector currently doesn't announce the tooltip content when focused. Need aria-describedby on the help icon. - Screen reader: when retention state changes to 'Indefinite' we should fire an aria-live polite message: "Retention set to Indefinite. Objects will not be auto-deleted." margo (Legal): we'd like the UI to use the phrase 'Data residency' where legal-facing customers will see it. But ok to show 'Region' as the short label with 'Data residency' in the tooltip/help copy. tom (Designer): updated copy suggestions: ``` Retention label: "Data retention" Options: "30 days", "90 days", "Indefinite" Retention hint (tooltip): "Indefinite: data retained until manually deleted by your org." Region label: "Region" (help: "Data residency: where your data is stored physically") Encryption: "Encryption: Redwood-managed" / "Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)" BYOK tooltip: "Bring your own key - link your cloud key to control encryption. Some keys are regional. See docs." Audit CTA: "Download audit trail" ``` rene (PM): Couple of product questions: 1) 'Indefinite' as standalone - claire raised SR ambiguity. Can we have the SR-only expansion? 2) Audit CTA - legal prefers 'audit report' but security prefers 'audit trail'. Which is less ambiguous? claire (Accessibility): For 1) yes, use visually-hidden expand: "Indefinite94data retained until you delete it" (screen-reader-only). Also ensure focus lands on the confirmation when changed. izzy (Security): For audit CTA, 'audit trail' is clearer for engineers. 'Report' could imply parsing/summaries. I'd vote 'Download audit trail'. margo (Legal): we can accept 'audit trail' if the confirmation modal includes a one-line note: "This export contains raw audit events and may include sensitive metadata." Good to have that in the download modal. kevin (Eng): small implementation snippet request from the designer re: a11y for the region help icon: ``` Data residency: physical location(s) where your data is stored. ``` tom (Designer): thanks kevin. I'll add that pattern. Also thinking about the encryption pillwe could add a small warning icon when BYOK is selected and compatibility is unknown: '!' with tooltip 'Key region mismatch possible'. claire (Accessibility): ensure the warning icon has aria-hidden="true" and the tooltip content is reachable via keyboard. Also color contrast on the warning must meet AA. rene (PM): Action items: - Tom: update Figma with visible SR-only text for 'Indefinite' and the aria-describedby pattern for region help. Also darken the encryption pill text and include a warning icon state. - Kevin: wire up the retention flag + compat check endpoint and the toast/modal text for audit download. - Izzy: draft tooltip copy + small docs link for BYOK compatibility. - Margo: approve the 'audit trail' language for the modal text (add that one-liner). - Claire: provide a 5-point a11y checklist for this modal (focus order, live region, contrast ratios, aria attributes, keyboard access). tom (Designer): will do. Quick micro-copy poll: 'Customer key (BYOK)' vs 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'? Shorter wins in the compact modal. izzy (Security): I'd prefer 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' because it clarifies it's managed by the customer. Slightly longer but clearer. margo (Legal): both ok. 'Customer-managed key' seems precise. rene (PM): Ok settled: use 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. I'll open the copy PR after tom uploads the final frames. Thanks all :rocket:
